title: John Florek: Every Single Drill Hole Has Hit Gold Since 2023
speaker: John Florek (CEO, Emperor Metals); host Jay Martin

macro_themes.view: Host sees gold starting its next leg up in a secular bull after an 8-9 month lull; guest uses ~$5,000 gold in economics.
CEO says the company missed the rerating peers got from higher gold and resource growth.

calls.reason: CEO argues fair value is at least ~$200M market cap (vs ~$100M now) given gold up 2.5x, Duquesne West resource doubled to ~1.5Moz and Lac Pelletier path to production (late 2028); catalysts: assays, updated 43-101, PEA/PFS.
calls.quote: I'm saying that a minimum we're at 200 million dollar market cap. We just broke 100 million dollar market cap.

calls.reason: Host (Jay Martin): gold quiet 8-9 months and now awakening into the next leg of a secular bull market.
calls.quote: The gold market is back on again right now. It's going to be in the next like incremental leg up in this secular bull

notes: Company promotional interview; guest is the CEO (talking his book). He says symbol 'AEMAUF' but spells E-M-A-U-F; recorded as EMAUF. Valuation given as market cap (~$100M now, >= $200M fair), not a share price, so target null. Gold price ~5,000 is a reference level used in the interview, approximate. No date stated in transcript.
